ec.name: JKBOPEE E-Counselling Instructions and Guidelines for admission to NEET PG (MD/MS/PGD)-2025

corr.name: J&K BOPEE, Corrigendum to Notification No. 021-BOPEE of 2026, 02-02-2026

r1.title: Round 1
chips: Resign by letter, then try Round 2
who: Registered candidates on the merit list who pay the Rs 2,000 counselling fee and lock preferences in time.
opts: Join the allotted college with original documents within the notified time. You can still try Round 2 for an upgrade, if it's held.
If interested, the candidate may participate in second round of counseling (if conducted) for upgradation after filling fresh preferences.
Your claim on the seat ends and the seat goes to the next round. You can still take part in Round 2.
If any candidate fails to join the allotted College/Institution within the stipulated time period as notified by the Board, his/her claim on the seat shall cease.

Give a resignation letter to the college; you can then take part in Round 2 with fresh preferences. If you no longer want the seat, resign by the last date fixed by NMC/MCI or the Board: if you don't, you're barred from the counselling in later years.
If a candidate after getting admission in a College/Institution intends to resign from the College/Institution, he/she can do so by submitting a resignation letter in the College/Institution.
ec: C.1, p.6; br: section 24, p.28
gaps: whether resigning inside the notified window still brings the bar for leaving midway (SRO 48 of 2018).

r2.title: Round 2
who: Those without a Round 1 seat, Round 1 joiners, those allotted who couldn't join, and those who resigned by the last date of admission of their Round 1 seat.
Registered candidates who skipped Round 1, on paying the Rs 2,000 fee; anyone who paid it in Round 1 doesn't pay again.
Round 1 choices are cancelled: fill fresh ones, or you aren't considered and keep any seat you've joined.
opts: Resign from the Round 1 college and join the new one.
If a candidate is upgraded, then he/she must relinquish/ resign from Round-1 College/ Institute and join Round-2 allotted College/Institute.
Your claim on the seat ends.
If any candidate fails to join the allotted College/Institution within the stipulated time period as notified by the Board, his/her claim on the seat shall cease.
Resign by letter to the college; you can then take part in Round 3.

If a candidate after getting admission in a College/Institution intends to resign from the College/Institution, he/she can do so by submitting a resignation letter in the College/Institution. If interested, such candidates (who have resigned) may participate in third round of counseling (if conducted) after filling fresh preferences.
gaps: a security deposit, or any penalty for not joining.

r3.title: Round 3
who: Those without a seat, joiners, those who couldn't join, and those who resigned from a Round 1 or 2 seat; registered candidates who haven't taken part yet pay Rs 2,000.
In 2025-26, registration reopened after the cut-off was lowered, and only candidates on the re-revised merit list (Annexure-A) could be allotted or upgraded.

The Round 3 notice says reserved seats left vacant for want of category candidates convert to open merit, and words this for the 3rd or Mop-Up round. A corrigendum of 02-02-2026 withdrew that notice's Mop-Up conditions and kept its other terms.
opts: Resign from the earlier college and join the Round 3 seat.
If a candidate is upgraded, then he/she must relinquish/ resign from Round-1/Round-2 College/ Institute and join Round-3 allotted College/Institute.
Your claim on the seat ends.
If any candidate fails to join the allotted College/Institution within the stipulated time period as notified by the Board, his/her claim on the seat shall cease.
Resign by letter; you can then take part in the Mop-Up round.
If interested, such candidates (who have resigned) may participate in Mop-up round of counseling (if conducted) after filling fresh preferences.
gaps: a resignation date in the Round 3 lists: the list that gave one (11-02-2026) was withdrawn, and the revised list doesn't restate it. The Mop-Up result of 17-02-2026 later let candidates admitted in Rounds 1 to 3 resign up to 4 PM on 19-02-2026.

stray.title: Mop-Up, then stray rounds
who: Mop-Up (in person at the Board's Jammu or Srinagar office): joined candidates who want an upgrade (with their college fee receipt), candidates without a seat, candidates allotted earlier who didn't join, and those who missed earlier rounds (they pay Rs 2,000).
Stray rounds: anyone who has joined and holds a seat, or who resigned a seat allotted in an earlier round, can't take part; those allotted earlier who didn't join can.
J&K ran two stray rounds in 2025-26 (23-02-2026, and 27-02-2026 for 16 leftover seats at ASCOMS).
opts: You must join it. If it's an upgrade, resign from the earlier college.
All candidates to whom a seat has been allotted in a Mop-Up round on the basis of merit-cum-preferences will have to compulsorily join college and course so allotted

It is made clear that in case the candidate who has been allotted a seat but does not join the allotted college/institution and/or fails to comply with necessary formalities, his/her admission shall be cancelled.
No upgrading in the stray rounds.
No upgradation is allowed during these stray or Special Rounds of Counselling.
gaps: a date to resign in the stray rounds.

after.title: Leaving the course
opts: Candidates who left an MD/MS/PG Diploma course midway can't take part in J&K's counselling for at least 3 years.

The candidates who were previously admitted to the MD/MS/PG Diploma courses but have left the same midway shall not be eligible for consideration/counseling atleast for 03 years for admission to MD /MS/PG Diploma Courses.

A joined candidate who no longer wants the seat must resign by the last date fixed by NMC/MCI or the Board; if they don't, they can't take part in the counselling in later years. Candidates selected after that date can't resign.

the selected candidates, who have completed their admission formalities but are no more interested in continuing their admission must resign by or before the last fixed by NMC/MCI or as decided by the Board failing which they shall not be eligible to participate in the counseling process for admission to MD/MS and other PG Diploma Course next year/subsequent years
Candidates on Ladakh merit seats (Central Pool or J&K State Pool) serve Ladakh for 3 years after a clinical PG degree, or pay Rs 50,00,000; after any other PG course, 2 years or Rs 45,00,000.
gaps: whether resigning inside the notified window still counts as leaving midway (SRO 48 of 2018).
any refund of the college fee on resigning.
whether the Ladakh bond reaches a Ladakh candidate on an open-merit seat: the order covers only Ladakh merit seats, while the brochure asks all Ladakh candidates for the undertaking.

reg: Rs 2,000 counselling fee, non-refundable, paid once and not again in later rounds: online in the online rounds, at a POS machine in the Board's Jammu or Srinagar office in the in-person rounds.
ec: p.1; n198: (vi)-(vii), p.1; n030: Note-I, p.1-2; n034: Note-I, p.1
lose: No deposit is stated; not joining ends your claim on the seat.
back: The counselling fee isn't refunded. A refund of the college fee isn't stated.
leave: At least 3 years barred from J&K's PG counselling. Ladakh merit seats: a 3-year service bond of Rs 50,00,000 (clinical courses).
br: section 12 Note (3), p.20; Annexure J, p.52-55
